ANTIFRAUD::alert_transaction_data
Description
This iRules command returns key-value list of all parameters marked to
be attached.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_transaction_data
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert transaction data: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_transaction_data]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
